subject: general
question:
Identify the best way to improve the bold part of the given sentence. If there is no improvement required, select ‘no improvement’.

Alex Trebek got a standing ovation as he accepted an Emmy Award as host of Jeopardy and **immediately setting the audience at ease**, even as he alluded to his cancer diagnosis.

options.text: immediately sets the audience at ease
immediately had set the audience at ease
immediately set the audience at ease

solution:
**The correct answer is option 3 i.e. immediately set the audience at ease.**

We need to write the bold part in **simple past **because the first part of the sentence is in simple past and both are connected with **AND.**

So, according to the rule of parallelism, we need to keep both in the same form.

The correct sentence will be-

**Alex Trebek got a standing ovation as he accepted an Emmy Award as host of Jeopardy and immediately set the audience at ease, even as he alluded to his cancer diagnosis.**
